WITH ab_trans AS (
  SELECT tr.ordertypedist
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
),
mix_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM ab_trans
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(count) AS total_count,
    COUNT(*) AS num_mixes
  FROM mix_counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    mc.ordertypedist,
    mc.count,
    CAST(mc.count AS numeric) / t.total_count AS share,
    1.0 / t.num_mixes AS avg_share
  FROM mix_counts mc
  CROSS JOIN totals t
)
SELECT 
  ordertypedist AS mix,
  count,
  share,
  share - avg_share AS above_average
FROM shares
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY share DESC;
